I refreshed the UI styling a bit and started splitting the app into smaller files.

What I changed:
- Updated the global styling in `src/index.css` for a more modern background and dark-mode treatment.
- Refactored `src/components/Header.tsx` to be a bit cleaner and more compact.
- Simplified `src/App.tsx` to reduce clutter while keeping behavior the same.
- Added a small shared UI helper file at `src/components/ui.tsx` for future component cleanup.

I didn’t change the app’s functionality. If you want, I can continue and split the remaining large components (`NotesView`, `ProfileView`, `AdminView`, `NoteEditorModal`, etc.) into smaller subcomponents too.
